mapper.select: select p.plant_cd, p.plant_nm, p.time_zone, p.sort_no, p.use_yn, p.row_ver from sys_plant p where p.use_yn = 'Y' order by p.sort_no, p.plant_cd
select use_yn from sys_plant where plant_cd = #{plantCd}
select s.start_time, s.end_time, s.break_min from mst_shift s where s.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and s.use_yn = 'Y' order by s.start_time, s.shift_cd
mapper.sql: w.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and w.status in ('PLANNED', 'RELEASED', 'IN_PROGRESS') and w.plan_start <= #{lastDay}
mapper.select: select w.wo_id, w.wo_no, w.status, w.item_id, w.plan_qty, w.unit_cd, w.priority, w.plan_start, w.plan_end, w.row_ver, coalesce(l.due_date, w.plan_end) as due_date, case when l.line_id is null then 'WO' else 'ORDER' end as due_src from prd_wo w left join sal_order_line l on l.line_id = w.order_line_id where order by w.wo_id limit #{limit}

select x.* from ( select p.wo_id, p.wo_proc_id, p.op_seq, p.proc_id, p.proc_cd, p.proc_nm, p.node_id, p.equip_id, m.outsrc_yn, p.std_ct_sec, p.units_per_cycle, p.setup_min, p.status as proc_status, p.row_ver as proc_row_ver, w.plan_qty - coalesce((select sum(r.good_qty) from prd_result r where r.wo_proc_id = p.wo_proc_id), 0) as qty from prd_wo w join prd_wo_proc p on p.wo_id = w.wo_id join mst_proc m on m.proc_id = p.proc_id where and w.status in ('RELEASED', 'IN_PROGRESS') and p.status <> 'DONE' union all select w.wo_id, null, s.op_seq, s.proc_id, m.proc_cd, m.proc_nm, s.node_id, null, m.outsrc_yn, s.std_ct_sec, s.units_per_cycle, s.setup_min, 'WAIT', null, w.plan_qty from prd_wo w join mst_routing_step s on s.routing_id = w.routing_id join mst_proc m on m.proc_id = s.proc_id where and w.status = 'PLANNED' ) x order by x.wo_id, x.op_seq limit #{limit}
select n.pin_id, n.wo_id, n.op_seq, n.res_kind, n.equip_id, n.node_id, n.start_at from aps_pin n where n.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and n.use_yn = 'Y'
select h.node_id, h.parent_id, h.node_cd, h.node_nm from mst_equip_hier h where h.plant_cd = #{plantCd}
select e.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, e.node_id, e.use_yn from mst_equip e where e.plant_cd = #{plantCd}

insert into aps_plan (comp_cd, plan_no, plant_cd, plan_nm, horizon_start, horizon_days, outsrc_lead_hr, time_zone, sched_from, sched_to, work_windows, calculated_by, wo_cnt, op_cnt, late_wo_cnt, unsched_op_cnt, makespan_end, calc_ms, off_days, mat_mode, mat_po, mat_short_wo_cnt, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{p.planNo}, #{p.plantCd}, #{p.planNm}, #{p.horizonStart}, #{p.horizonDays}, #{p.outsrcLeadHr}, #{p.timeZone}, #{p.schedFrom}, #{p.schedTo}, cast(#{p.workWindows} as jsonb), #{by}, #{p.woCnt}, #{p.opCnt}, #{p.lateWoCnt}, #{p.unschedOpCnt}, #{p.makespanEnd}, #{p.calcMs}, cast(#{p.offDays} as jsonb), #{p.matMode}, #{p.matPo}, #{p.matShortWoCnt}, #{by}, #{by}) returning plan_id
mapper.insert:
insert into aps_plan_wo (comp_cd, plan_id, seq, wo_id, wo_no, wo_status, item_id, plan_qty, unit_cd, priority, plan_start, plan_end, start_at, end_at, late_yn, exc_cd, wo_row_ver, due_date, due_src, mat_cd) values
(hb_current_comp(), #{planId}, #{r.seq}, #{r.woId}, #{r.woNo}, #{r.woStatus}, #{r.itemId}, #{r.planQty}, #{r.unitCd}, #{r.priority}, #{r.planStart}, #{r.planEnd}, #{r.startAt}, #{r.endAt}, #{r.lateYn}, #{r.excCd}, #{r.woRowVer}, #{r.dueDate}, #{r.dueSrc}, #{r.matCd})
mapper.select: select x.plan_wo_id, x.wo_id from aps_plan_wo x where x.plan_id = #{planId}
mapper.insert:
insert into aps_plan_op (comp_cd, plan_id, plan_wo_id, wo_id, wo_proc_id, op_seq, proc_id, proc_cd, proc_nm, node_id, equip_id, res_kind, qty, setup_sec, run_sec, start_at, end_at, exc_cd, proc_row_ver, pin_id, warn_cd) values
(hb_current_comp(), #{planId}, #{r.planWoId}, #{r.woId}, #{r.woProcId}, #{r.opSeq}, #{r.procId}, #{r.procCd}, #{r.procNm}, #{r.nodeId}, #{r.equipId}, #{r.resKind}, #{r.qty}, #{r.setupSec}, #{r.runSec}, #{r.startAt}, #{r.endAt}, #{r.excCd}, #{r.procRowVer}, #{r.pinId}, #{r.warnCd})

insert into aps_plan_mat (comp_cd, plan_id, plan_wo_id, wo_id, op_seq, src_op_seq, item_id, need_qty, unit_cd, need_at, alloc_qty, short_qty, covered_at) values
(hb_current_comp(), #{planId}, #{r.planWoId}, #{r.woId}, #{r.opSeq}, #{r.srcOpSeq}, #{r.itemId}, #{r.needQty}, #{r.unitCd}, #{r.needAt}, #{r.allocQty}, #{r.shortQty}, #{r.coveredAt})

insert into aps_plan_supply (comp_cd, plan_id, item_id, kind, supply_at, qty, unit_cd, po_no, po_line_no, promised_yn, base_unit_yn) values
(hb_current_comp(), #{planId}, #{r.itemId}, #{r.kind}, #{r.supplyAt}, #{r.qty}, #{r.unitCd}, #{r.poNo}, #{r.poLineNo}, #{r.promisedYn}, #{r.baseUnitYn})
mapper.select: select m.wo_id, x.wo_no, m.op_seq, m.src_op_seq, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, trim_scale(m.need_qty)::text as need_qty, trim_scale(m.alloc_qty)::text as alloc_qty, trim_scale(m.short_qty)::text as short_qty, m.unit_cd, m.need_at, m.covered_at, trim_scale(coalesce((select sum(s.qty) from aps_plan_supply s where s.plan_id = m.plan_id and s.item_id = m.item_id and s.base_unit_yn = 'Y'), 0))::text as supply_qty, m.plan_mat_id, i.proc_type, (select string_agg(distinct r.pr_no, ', ' order by r.pr_no) from aps_plan_pr k join srm_pr r on r.pr_id = k.pr_id where k.plan_mat_id = m.plan_mat_id and r.status not in ('CANCELLED', 'REJECTED') and exists (select 1 from srm_pr_line l where l.pr_line_id = k.pr_line_id)) as pr_no from aps_plan_mat m join aps_plan_wo x on x.plan_wo_id = m.plan_wo_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = m.item_id where m.plan_id = #{id} order by (m.short_qty > 0) desc, x.seq, m.op_seq, i.item_cd limit 2000
select status from aps_plan where plan_id = #{id} for update
select w.wo_id from prd_wo w where w.wo_id in (select x.wo_id from aps_plan_wo x where x.plan_id = #{planId}) order by w.wo_id for update of w

select x.wo_id, x.wo_no, x.wo_row_ver, x.plan_end as snap_end, x.start_at, x.end_at, x.exc_cd, w.status as cur_status, w.row_ver as cur_row_ver, w.plan_start as cur_start, w.plan_end as cur_end, (select f.fence_days from aps_item_param f where f.plant_cd = w.plant_cd and f.item_id = w.item_id and f.use_yn = 'Y') as item_fence_days, exists (select 1 from aps_plan_op o join aps_pin n on n.pin_id = o.pin_id where o.plan_id = x.plan_id and o.wo_id = x.wo_id and length(btrim(coalesce(n.remark, ''))) > 0) as pin_reason from aps_plan_wo x join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = x.wo_id where x.plan_id = #{planId} order by x.seq

select o.wo_id, o.wo_proc_id, o.op_seq, o.proc_cd, o.proc_row_ver, o.res_kind, o.equip_id, e.equip_cd, o.start_at is not null as scheduled, p.row_ver as cur_row_ver, p.equip_id as cur_equip_id, ce.equip_cd as cur_equip_cd from aps_plan_op o join prd_wo_proc p on p.wo_proc_id = o.wo_proc_id left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = o.equip_id left join mst_equip ce on ce.equip_id = p.equip_id where o.plan_id = #{planId} order by o.wo_id, o.op_seq
select w.wo_no from prd_wo w where and not exists (select 1 from aps_plan_wo x where x.plan_id = #{planId} and x.wo_id = w.wo_id) order by w.wo_no limit 50

select o.wo_id, x.wo_no, o.op_seq, o.proc_cd, o.proc_nm, o.res_kind, case o.res_kind when 'EQUIP' then e.equip_cd when 'NODE' then h.node_cd end as res_cd, o.start_at, o.end_at, o.exc_cd from aps_plan_op o join aps_plan_wo x on x.plan_wo_id = o.plan_wo_id left join mst_equip_hier h on h.node_id = o.node_id left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = o.equip_id where o.plan_id = #{id} order by x.wo_no, o.op_seq
mapper.sql: select o.plan_op_id, o.plan_id, a.plant_cd, o.wo_id, o.op_seq, o.node_id, m.outsrc_yn, w.status as wo_status, p.status as proc_status, p.equip_id as cur_equip_id from aps_plan_op o join aps_plan a on a.plan_id = o.plan_id join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = o.wo_id join mst_proc m on m.proc_id = o.proc_id left join prd_wo_proc p on p.wo_id = o.wo_id and p.op_seq = o.op_seq
mapper.select: where o.plan_op_id = #{id}
where o.plan_id = #{planId} and o.wo_id = #{woId} and o.op_seq = #{opSeq}

insert into aps_pin (comp_cd, plant_cd, wo_id, op_seq, res_kind, equip_id, node_id, start_at, src_plan_id, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{op.plantCd}, #{op.woId}, #{op.opSeq}, #{kind}, #{equipId}, #{nodeId}, #{startAt}, #{op.planId}, #{remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning pin_id
select n.pin_id, n.plant_cd, n.wo_id, n.op_seq, n.res_kind, n.equip_id, n.node_id, n.start_at, n.src_plan_id, n.row_ver from aps_pin n where n.pin_id = #{id} and n.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: update aps_pin set use_yn = 'N', row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where pin_id = #{id} and use_yn = 'Y' and row_ver = #{rowVer}
mapper.select: select n.pin_id, n.plant_cd, n.wo_id, w.wo_no, w.status as wo_status, n.op_seq, o.proc_cd, o.proc_nm, n.res_kind, n.equip_id, n.node_id, case n.res_kind when 'EQUIP' then e.equip_cd when 'NODE' then h.node_cd end as res_cd, n.start_at, n.src_plan_id, a.plan_no as src_plan_no, n.updated_by, n.updated_at, n.row_ver from aps_pin n join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = n.wo_id join aps_plan a on a.plan_id = n.src_plan_id left join aps_plan_op o on o.plan_id = n.src_plan_id and o.wo_id = n.wo_id and o.op_seq = n.op_seq left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = n.equip_id left join mst_equip_hier h on h.node_id = n.node_id where n.use_yn = 'Y' and n.plant_cd = #{plantCd} order by n.start_at, w.wo_no, n.op_seq limit 1000
mapper.sql: a.plan_id, a.plan_no, a.plant_cd, p.plant_nm, a.plan_nm, a.rule_cd, a.horizon_start, a.horizon_days, a.outsrc_lead_hr, a.time_zone, a.sched_from, a.sched_to, a.status, a.calculated_at, a.calculated_by, a.wo_cnt, a.op_cnt, a.late_wo_cnt, a.unsched_op_cnt, a.makespan_end, a.calc_ms, jsonb_array_length(a.off_days) as off_day_cnt, a.mat_mode, a.mat_po, a.mat_short_wo_cnt, a.discard_reason, a.remark, a.purged_at, a.applied_at, a.applied_by, a.applied_wo_cnt, a.applied_op_cnt, a.row_ver, case when a.status = 'APPLIED' and not exists (select 1 from aps_plan b where b.plant_cd = a.plant_cd and b.status = 'APPLIED' and (b.applied_at > a.applied_at or (b.applied_at = a.applied_at and b.plan_id > a.plan_id))) then 'Y' else 'N' end as current_yn
mapper.select:
select
order by
a.plan_no desc a.plan_nm desc nulls last a.plant_cd desc a.horizon_start desc a.late_wo_cnt desc a.unsched_op_cnt desc a.status desc a.calculated_at desc ,
a.plan_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}

select s.op_seq, s.proc_id, m.proc_cd, m.proc_nm, s.node_id, null as equip_id, m.outsrc_yn, s.std_ct_sec, s.units_per_cycle, s.setup_min, 'WAIT' as proc_status, #{qty} as qty from mst_routing_step s join mst_proc m on m.proc_id = s.proc_id where s.routing_id = #{routingId} order by s.op_seq
select i.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm from mst_item i where i.item_id in #{id}
select count(*)
select off_days::text from aps_plan where plan_id = #{id}
select work_windows::text from aps_plan where plan_id = #{id}

select x.plan_wo_id, x.seq, x.wo_id, x.wo_no, x.wo_status, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, trim_scale(x.plan_qty)::text as plan_qty, x.unit_cd, x.priority, x.plan_start, x.plan_end, x.due_date, x.due_src, x.start_at, x.end_at, x.late_yn, x.exc_cd, x.mat_cd from aps_plan_wo x join mst_item i on i.item_id = x.item_id where x.plan_id = #{id} order by x.seq

select o.plan_op_id, o.wo_id, x.wo_no, x.seq, x.late_yn, o.op_seq, o.proc_cd, o.proc_nm, o.node_id, h.node_cd, h.node_nm, o.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, o.res_kind, trim_scale(o.qty)::text as qty, x.unit_cd, o.setup_sec, o.run_sec, o.start_at, o.end_at, o.exc_cd, o.pin_id, o.warn_cd, case when exists (select 1 from aps_plan_mat m where m.plan_id = o.plan_id and m.wo_id = o.wo_id and m.op_seq = o.op_seq and m.short_qty > 0) then 'Y' else 'N' end as mat_short_yn from aps_plan_op o join aps_plan_wo x on x.plan_wo_id = o.plan_wo_id left join mst_equip_hier h on h.node_id = o.node_id left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = o.equip_id where o.plan_id = #{id} and o.start_at is not null and o.start_at is null order by o.start_at, x.seq, o.op_seq
